label: Wait
title: Wait
subtitle: Pauses agent execution for a specified number of milliseconds. Useful for rate limiting between API calls, waiting for an external process to complete, or introducing a delay between steps.
whenToUse: Use when an agent is polling an external system that has rate limits, or when a previous action (like triggering a build) needs time to complete before the agent checks the result.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Pauses execution for the specified duration in milliseconds. Default: 1000ms. Maximum: 300,000ms (5 minutes).

mediaCaption: A Wait action card showing the duration in milliseconds and a note explaining what the agent is waiting for
